note: Curated, manually-maintained lookup table of CMMC assessment status by CAGE code / business name. There is no public real-time feed of certified entities — authoritative status lives in DoD SPRS / eMASS and is not public — so seed entries marked "sample": true are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders to demonstrate the tool. Replace them with verified entries (cite a public source per row) as you confirm them.

levels.Level 1: Annual self-assessment, 15 safeguarding requirements (FAR 52.204-21). Protects Federal Contract Information (FCI). No C3PAO involved.
levels.Level 2: NIST SP 800-171 (110 controls) for Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). Most CUI contracts require a triennial third-party assessment by a C3PAO; some are self-assessed.
levels.Level 3: Highest tier. NIST SP 800-171 plus selected NIST SP 800-172 enhancements, assessed by the government (DIBCAC), not a C3PAO. For the most sensitive CUI.

statusMeanings.certified: Final CMMC certification achieved (assessment passed, no open POA&M).
statusMeanings.conditional: Conditional certification — passed with an open Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M); must close out within 180 days for Final status.
statusMeanings.in-progress: Assessment scheduled or underway with a C3PAO; no certificate issued yet.
statusMeanings.self: Self-assessment on record (Level 1, or a self-assessed Level 2) — not a C3PAO certification.
statusMeanings.expired: Prior certification has lapsed (CMMC certifications are valid for 3 years).
statusMeanings.none: No CMMC assessment record found in this index.
